title: Connection playback + cost simulator for private console rollout surface
creator: Arianna Patel
description: Design and prototype a compact operator surface inside the Private Console that lets tenant operators: (1) replay recent cluster connection/egress incidents as an interactive timeline (scenario playback), (2) simulate rollout strategies (canary, linear, staged) against a synthetic traffic generator, and (3) project egress and compute cost exposure for each rollout scenario. This ticket covers the high-fidelity prototype, annotated interaction spec, and a short usability script the Solutions team can run during pilot onboarding.
design_goals: Surface the minimal set of signals operators need to decide whether to proceed with a rollout (latency spike, error rate, egress change, KV cache hit-rate)
Allow exploratory "playback" of real incident traces with scrubbed tenant identifiers so operators can reproduce decision points
Make cost impact visible per-rollout-stage (per-minute and per-month projection) with toggles for quantization/batching profiles
Provide safe-to-execute quick actions (pause rollout, rollback, pause-traffic, throttle-egress) wired to runbook hooks
constraints_and_tradeoffs: Privacy: playback uses scrubbed traces and synthetic traffic to avoid exposing PII/customer data; adds complexity to the backend export pipeline
Surface density: we prioritize compact, glanceable cards over fully expanded telemetry panels to keep the console usable on smaller screens
Accuracy vs speed: cost projections will be heuristic (based on recent TTI and batching profiles) — accurate enough for decisions but not a billing-grade estimator
Safety: quick actions must require a two-step confirmation when affecting >10% of cluster capacity; design introduces friction for safety
interaction_notes: Primary entry: Cluster > Tenant > 'Playback & Rollout' tab (new)
Playback timeline has a scrubber and discrete 'events' (connectivity loss, KV-cache miss surge, egress spike). Hover opens a contextual mini-chart and recommended rollback threshold.
Scenario builder: select start/end window, synthetic qps multiplier, failure mode toggle (packet-loss, high-latency, KV-cold), rollout strategy dropdown
Cost simulator shows immediate per-minute delta and projected 30-day exposure, with a toggle to view compute vs egress components
Quick actions: Run canary (10%), Pause, Rollback to pinned model version — each action surfaces estimated downstream impact and requires operator confirmation
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma prototype covering playback timeline + scenario builder flows produced
Interaction spec with keyboard/accessibility notes and confirmation patterns documented on Confluence
Three pilot-run usability sessions scheduled with Solutions/Support, notes captured and at least two actionable UX changes identified
Frontend engineering review completed and a PR opened with a minimal scaffold for the UI routes (link in comments)
Product approves rollout gating behavior and cost projection heuristics
review_feedback: PM (Lena Hoffman): Emphasize clear defaults for synthetic traffic — operators should not accidentally trigger high-cost sims
Eng (Sven Ortega): Backend needs a compact trace export endpoint (max 5MB) — prototype should include a streaming placeholder rather than full trace dump
Security (Maya Chen): Add explicit scrubber step in the playback pipeline; mock links in the prototype must not call live tenant IDs
Design review (Priya Kamat): Card density is good but mobile layout needs stacking rules for timeline + cost tiles
decisions: Use scrubbed trace + synthetic traffic model for playback to avoid PII and simplify permissions
Default rollout strategy for the simulator will be 'canary 10% then 30% after 10m' with editable stages
Cost projections will include two views: conservative and optimistic (based on batching/quantization toggles)
Quick actions will require a secondary confirmation modal for changes >10% capacity
